# qBittorrent WebUI licensing

The vendored files in `upstream` come from qBittorrent and retain their original
copyright and license notices.

qBittorrent states:

- source code: GNU GPL version 2 or, at the recipient's option, any later
  version;
- binary distributions containing GPLv3+ assets: GNU GPL version 3 or, at the
  recipient's option, any later version.

The authoritative copied texts are in `licenses/`. OpenNet-specific code outside
this directory is not automatically covered by this notice; the compatibility
design's repository-wide licensing gate must be resolved before distribution.
